title: WkTaskList: Intelligent Management (T3 ref)
desc: T3 reference tier. History and technical evolution of the upgraded wktasklist. Documents scaling changes and philosophy.
steps: EVOLUTION: v1.0 used raw милли온-scale scores based on CPU*200. v5.0 introduced 0-100 normalization using sigmoid-like dampening to keep high-impact processes at 99.99 for readability.
FORMATTING: user requirement 2026-06-06 mandated fixed XX.YY format (정수 두자리, 소수점 두자리) for all SCORE values to ensure table alignment and professional look.
INTEGRATION: wkdoctor now uses 'wktasklist -Json' output as its primary data source, sharing the 9-second cache and reducing expensive WMI queries during emergency situations.
SANCTUARY DESIGN: the 'Quant Sanctuary' (-5,000) was established to protect Kiwoom HTS engines from accidental reaper kills, prioritizing financial signal integrity over raw system resource recovery.
